title: cloudflare-deploy: check-tools.sh
description: Script that verifies Node.js version, installs pinned Wrangler if needed, and prints versions before deployment.

steps.description: Header: shebang, comment describing purpose, strict error handling.
Node check: verify node is installed, set required version 22.12.0, compare with sort -V.
Wrangler: install from node_modules/wrangler if not present, using npm ci.
Output: print Node version and Wrangler version.
